# govulncheck exclusions: one Go vulnerability ID per line, '#' starts a comment.
#
# Read by scripts/govulncheck.sh (`task vulncheck`, CI job `govulncheck`).
# Every finding govulncheck reports as called by picolet fails the job unless
# its ID is listed here. Only findings that were already on main when the
# job was added are listed: all of them reach picolet through the Podman
# bindings (github.com/containers/podman/v5 and the containers modules it
# pulls in) and have no fixed version picolet can move to on its own.
# Remove an entry once a dependency bump fixes it (the script warns about
# entries that no longer match a finding). Standard-library findings are
# never listed: they are fixed by a Go patch release, and the CI job always
# runs the latest patch of the go.mod Go version.

# github.com/containers/podman/v5 (no fixed version)
GO-2024-3042
GO-2025-3961

# github.com/containers/buildah, via the Podman bindings (no fixed version)
GO-2026-5116

# github.com/docker/docker, via the Podman bindings (no fixed version)
GO-2026-4883
GO-2026-4887

# golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp, via go.podman.io/image/v5/signature (no fixed version)
GO-2026-5932

# github.com/sigstore/fulcio, via go.podman.io/image/v5/signature (fixed in
# fulcio v1.8.x, which go.podman.io/image does not require yet)
GO-2025-4193
GO-2026-4311
GO-2026-5853
